node.description: The node's name, as the node service lists it. Name the node by this or by account, one of the two.

account.description: The account whose node it is, by its id, in place of node: the node agency's record of a person's node names for the account. An account with no node is refused.

command.description: The command's text, run whole by the shell.

shell.description: The shell the agent runs the command in; the node's own where none is named: powershell on a Windows host, linux otherwise. A Windows host runs powershell and wsl, any other host linux. A wsl command reaches bash as written.

cwd.description: The folder the command runs in; the agent's own where none is named.

env.description: Variables laid over the agent's environment for this command.

distro.description: The WSL distribution a wsl command runs in; the default one where none is named.

secrets.description: Saved secrets the command is handed by name, never by value: the platform's for the administrator, the caller's own account's otherwise. A file of KEY=VALUE fields is handed as variables named by its keys; a file of one value is written to a file on the node, removed when the command ends, whose path is in BMO_SECRET_<STEM>_FILE, the stem being the name in capitals with other characters made underscores. A value the command prints is masked in the answer.

oneOf.description: The secret's name, a plain file name.

name.description: The secret's name, a plain file name.

prefix.description: Written before each field's key in its variable's name.

as.description: Variables, a file on the node, or both: env for a file of fields and file for a file of one value where none is named. One value as a variable is BMO_SECRET_<STEM>.
